notes.title: Chroma Blasters - Steam Deck Compatibility Details
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! We've tested [b]Chroma Blasters[/b] extensively on Steam Deck both during development and after release, and here’s what you can expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]Controls[/b]: Twin-stick layout maps 1-for-1 to the Deck’s analog sticks & triggers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance[/b]: Runs great with ~60fps framerate throughout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visuals & UI[/b]: All effects on, text sized appropriately for the smaller screens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cloud & Achievements[/b]: Scores & Achievements sync seamlessly between Deck and desktop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battery Life:[/b] ~3hrs 40mins on LCD models, ~5hrs 30mins on OLED at 60fps.[/p][/*][/list][p]If Valve asks you for feedback on the Deck experience, please let them know, every report helps us earn that green “Verified” badge.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy blasting on the go!
- Stephen @ Atomic Elk[/p]

notes.title: Chroma Blasters is a challenging music-driven twin-stick arcade shooter
notes.content:
Love music and twin-stick shooter high-score challenges? Chroma Blasters is one you need to try, and there's a demo available.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/chroma-blasters-is-a-challenging-music-driven-twin-stick-arcade-shooter/
